record.bio: Olivier Faure (born 18 August 1968 in La Tronche, Isère) is a French Socialist politician who joined the PS in 1984. He was deputy chief of staff to François Hollande at the PS (2000-2007) and has been deputy for Seine-et-Marne's 11th constituency since June 2012. He has been First Secretary of the Parti socialiste since April 2018 and was re-elected in 2021, 2023 and June 2025. He backed the NUPES alliance in 2022 and the Nouveau Front populaire in 2024. In July 2025 he helped agree the principle of a common left candidate for 2027, though PS members later voted for a primary limited to the socialist pole. He announced his presidential bid on 30 August 2026, published the book "La loi du plus juste" on 17 September 2026, and is running in the PS/Place publique primary of October 2026.
offices: President of the Socialist group in the Assemblée nationale (SER, renamed Nouvelle Gauche in 2017)

reversals.topic: Use of article 49.3 for the 2026 budget
reversals.before: Autumn 2025: the PS made non-use of article 49.3 for the 2026 budget one of its conditions for not censuring the Lecornu government, and obtained that commitment
reversals.after: Late January 2026: accepted that the government use 49.3 to adopt the 2026 budget because no majority could be found, against opposition from other left parties

delivery.what: Had an amendment adopted in December 2014 that enabled the single-fare Pass Navigo in Île-de-France
delivery.assessment: Cited as a concrete parliamentary achievement in his Wikipedia profile. It has not been independently assessed, and no sources of differing leanings were consulted.

delivery.what: Kept the PS in left alliances: NUPES 2022, NFP 2024, and a common-candidate principle for 2027 agreed in Bagneux in July 2025
delivery.assessment: Credited with keeping the PS in a union strategy. Opponents inside the PS, who would rather back Raphaël Glucksmann in a federation, accuse him of being subordinate to Mélenchon/LFI. PS members later rejected his preferred open primary (55.5% backed a primary limited to the socialist pole). Only Wikipedia was consulted.

delivery.what: Negotiated a suspension of the 2023 pension reform with PM Lecornu in late 2025 (legal age frozen at 62 years 9 months until January 2028), which was voted on 12 November 2025 in the PLFSS 2026; he voted for the PLFSS on final reading on 16 December 2025
delivery.assessment: A concrete concession obtained while the PS was in opposition. Other left parties criticised the compromise. No sources of differing leanings were obtained.
